entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return my VeloBand GPS tracker. It's just not for me.
Okay, I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
No, it works fine. Honestly, it was just an impulse buy and I've changed my mind. I just don't use it, and I want a refund.
I understand. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order number is... uh... VF789012.
Thank you, Mark. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered on January 4th of this year, which was 19 days ago. Is that correct?
Sounds about right. So, let's get this return started.

Well, Mark, for the VeloBand Pulse model specifically, our return policy is 10 days from the date of delivery. This is because once the device is activated, it's linked to a user account, and for hygiene reasons, we can't accept it back after that window. Since we're at day 19, I'm afraid I can't process a return for a refund.
ARE YOU KIDDING ME? Ten days?! That's outrageous! I spent over two hundred dollars on this thing! This is a complete scam!
I do understand your frustration, sir. That policy is specific to our electronic wearables and is stated on the product page before purchase.
I don't care what your website says! This is terrible customer service! I want to speak to your manager, right now! This is unacceptable!
I can appreciate your position, but my manager has to adhere to the same policy and would tell you the same thing. I do, however, have an alternative solution I can offer you.
There is no solution besides my money back! I'm going to leave a one-star review on every website I can find. People need to know how you treat your customers!

I hear you, and I do want to help. While a refund to VeloFit is not possible, we have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform we host for customers to sell their gently used gear to other VeloFit enthusiasts. Since you don't use the band, this is the best way to get most of your money back for it.
Wait... a resale site? So you won't take it back, but you'll help me sell it to someone else? What's the catch?

There's no catch at all. We want to ensure our products get used by the community. It's a secure platform where you can list your VeloBand, and buyers know they're getting a genuine product. It's the designated solution for situations just like this, for an impulse buy outside the return window.
Hmph. So I can still get my money back, just from someone else?
Exactly. You set the price, and because the device is so new, they often sell very quickly and for a good value. It's a much better option than having it sit in a drawer.
Fine. Okay, fine. That's better than nothing, I guess. Send me the information for this marketplace thing.
Of course. I've just sent an email to the address on file with a direct link and a simple guide to creating your listing. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
No. That's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
